{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the premises
print("Status values:", df['status'].unique())
print("Number of completed orders:", df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0])

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any revenue values contain commas (thousands separators)
print("Sample revenue values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Extract only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_float'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA orders if any
# But we already saw 0 QA orders
print("Number of QA orders in completed set:", len(df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']))

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
